recent_news.headline: Class B CDL Driver - Hazardous & Non-Hazardous Waste Transportation
recent_news.summary: Triumvirate Environmental seeking Class B CDL driver in Somerville, MA for hazardous and non-hazardous waste material transport. Competitive benefits including health insurance, 401k matching, safety training, and tuition reimbursement offered.

backfill_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires HydroTech Environmental, LLC
backfill_news.summary: Wind River Environmental, the leading provider of non-hazardous liquid waste services in the Eastern United States, has acquired HydroTech Environmental, LLC, which specializes in sludge and non-sludge hauling across Pennsylvania. This strategic acquisition strengthens Wind River's local operations and service capabilities in the Mid Atlantic.
